symbolDescription: The token tree. Every field is optional in overrides via `DeepPartial`.

optionDescriptions.name: Identifies the theme in `data-theme` and in the docs site.
optionDescriptions.font: The chrome’s typography, which is separate from the content’s.
optionDescriptions.color: The palette every other group draws from.
optionDescriptions.editor: The content box: its size, its border and its focus ring.
optionDescriptions.button: Toolbar controls, in each of their states.
optionDescriptions.footer: The row below the content holding the helper text and the counter.
optionDescriptions.counter: The counter, in each of its three states.
optionDescriptions.content: Prose styles, shipped separately so stored content renders identically anywhere.
optionDescriptions.motion: Transition timing, which `prefers-reduced-motion` overrides to none.
optionDescriptions.z: Stacking, so the editor can sit inside an application’s own layers.
optionDescriptions.density: A multiplier over sizes and paddings, so it composes with any theme.
